purpose: Phase-7B vascular prediction records. Each documents a labelled prediction: relative perfusion / delivery / permeability / oxygen availability - never a fabricated absolute blood flow, vessel count, oxygen partial pressure, vascular diameter, or perfusion rate.

pred_va_b16bl6.claim: The abnormal B16BL6 melanoma vasculature (highly vascularized but immature/chaotic, poorly perfused, leaky) yields moderate-to-limited effective drug delivery and moderate oxygen supply relative to a well-perfused mature network.
pred_va_b16bl6.rationale: General tumour-vasculature biology: high density + high permeability (EPR-style) is offset by poor perfusion + immaturity; applied predictively (no direct dataset).
pred_va_b16bl6.uncertainty: Relative delivery/perfusion/oxygen only; all quantities NOT_REPORTED.
pred_va_b16bl6.limitations: Not a measured vasculature; schematic ordinal.

pred_va_human.claim: The predicted human skin/tumour vasculature (moderately vascularized, developing, moderate perfusion) yields moderate effective delivery - exploratory only.
pred_va_human.rationale: Human skin vascular architecture is literature-known; applied predictively with distinct values (not copied from mouse).
pred_va_human.limitations: Exploratory; not shown by default; not validated for human clinical response.
